text_en: “But now, hear my speech, O Job, and listen to all my words.
text_cn: 约伯，请你且听我的话，侧耳静听我说的一切。

text_en: See, I open my mouth; the tongue in my mouth speaks.
text_cn: 请看，我已开口，舌头已在口腔内发言。

text_en: My words declare the uprightness of my heart, and what my lips know they speak sincerely.
text_cn: 我的话是出于正直的心，我的唇舌要清楚说明真理。

text_en: The spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
text_cn: 天主的神造了我，全能者的气息使我生活。

text_en: Answer me, if you can; set your words in order before me; take your stand.
text_cn: 你如果能够，就回答我，请准备好，来对抗我。

text_en: See, before God I am as you are; I too was formed from a piece of clay.
text_cn: 看，我与你在天主前都是一样，我也是用泥土造成的。

text_en: No fear of me need terrify you; my pressure will not be heavy on you.
text_cn: 所以我的威吓不会使你恐怖，我的手也不会重压在你身上。

text_en: “Surely, you have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the sound of your words.
text_cn: 你所说的，我已耳闻，听到了你所说的话：

text_en: You say, ‘I am clean, without transgression; I am pure, and there is no iniquity in me.
text_cn: “我本纯洁无罪，清白无瑕。

text_en: Look, he finds occasions against me, he counts me as his enemy;
text_cn: 但天主却在我身上找错，视我为他的对头；

text_en: he puts my feet in the stocks, and watches all my paths. ’
text_cn: 他把我的脚缚在木桩上，窥察我的一切行动。”

text_en: “But in this you are not right. I will answer you: God is greater than any mortal.
text_cn: 我答复你说：你这话说的不对，因为天主远超世人。

text_en: Why do you contend against him, saying, ‘He will answer none of my words’?
text_cn: 他既不答复你说的一切话，你为何还同他争辩？

text_en: For God speaks in one way, and in two, though people do not perceive it.
text_cn: 原来天主用一种方法向人讲话，人若不理会，他再用另一种方法：

text_en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on mortals, while they slumber on their beds,
text_cn: 天主有时藉梦和夜间的异像，当人躺在床上沉睡的时候，

text_en: then he opens their ears, and terrifies them with warnings,
text_cn: 开启人的听觉，用异像惊吓他，

text_en: that he may turn them aside from their deeds, and keep them from pride,
text_cn: 使人脱离恶念，使人铲除骄傲，

text_en: to spare their souls from the Pit, their lives from traversing the River.
text_cn: 阻拦他陷于阴府，救他的性命脱离沟壑。

text_en: They are also chastened with pain upon their beds, and with continual strife in their bones,
text_cn: 天主也有时惩罚人在床上受痛苦，使他的骨头不断的刺痛，

text_en: so that their lives loathe bread, and their appetites dainty food.
text_cn: 以致他讨厌食物，他的心厌恶美味。

text_en: Their flesh is so wasted away that it cannot be seen; and their bones, once invisible, now stick out.
text_cn: 他身上的肉已消逝不见，他枯瘦的骨头，已开始外露。

text_en: Their souls draw near the Pit, and their lives to those who bring death.
text_cn: 他的灵魂已临近墓穴，他的生命已接近死亡之所。

text_en: Then, if there should be for one of them an angel, a mediator, one of a thousand, one who declares a person upright,
text_cn: 一千天使中，若有一个在他身旁，作他的代言人，提醒他应行的义务，

text_en: and he is gracious to that person, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down into the Pit; I have found a ransom;
text_cn: 且怜悯那人，为他转求说：“求你拯救他，以免陷于阴府，因为我已找到了赎金。”

text_en: let his flesh become fresh with youth; let him return to the days of his youthful vigor’;
text_cn: 他的肉身比少年人的肉身必更健美，他的青春岁月又恢复了。

text_en: then he prays to God, and is accepted by him, he comes into his presence with joy, and God repays him for his righteousness.
text_cn: 他祈求天主，必获得悦纳。他必欢然得见天主的仪容，天主也必恢复他的正义。

text_en: That person sings to others and says, ‘I sinned, and perverted what was right, and it was not paid back to me.
text_cn: 那时，他将在人前重述所经历的事说：“我犯了罪，颠倒了是非，但他没有照我的罪罚我。

text_en: He has redeemed my soul from going down to the Pit, and my life shall see the light. ’
text_cn: 他救了我生命免入阴府，使我重见光明。”

text_en: “God indeed does all these things, twice, three times, with mortals,
text_cn: 这就是天主接二连三为人所做的事，

text_en: to bring back their souls from the Pit, so that they may see the light of life.
text_cn: 挽救他脱离阴府，重见生命之光。

text_en: Pay heed, Job, listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
text_cn: 约伯啊！请留神倾听，静静地听我说话！

text_en: If you have anything to say, answer me; speak, for I desire to justify you.
text_cn: 你若有话说，请即回复我，你尽管说，因为我愿听你的理。

text_en: If not, listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom. ”
text_cn: 若没有话，且听我说，静听我要教给你的智慧。
